notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron, targeting Vampire Charmseeker
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Vampire Charmseeker and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.
